configs.name: Vanilla (1-day hold)
configs.description: Exit at next day close. No filters, no trailing stop.

configs.name: Trail Stop (3-day max)
configs.description: Trail activates at +1.5R, distance 1.5×ATR. Exit at trail or 3 days.

configs.name: Trail Stop (Forever)
configs.description: Trail activates at +1.5R, distance 1.5×ATR. No time limit — hold until trail hits.
